title: LionShiftGG — Arena Shift Scheduling Discord Bot

overview.purpose: Purdue Northwest (PNW) esports arena shift scheduling, student worker management, and shift trading bot. Integrates tightly with the Nova web dashboard's LionShift Dashboard (chapter 08).
overview.stack: discord.py >= 2.3.0, Python 3.10+, Pillow (schedule image generation), tzdata (America/Chicago)

env_vars.GGLEAP_API_KEY: Optional, currently unused placeholder for future guest tracking

constants_py.DIRECTOR_ID: Discord user ID of the arena director (approval flows/alerts)

persistence_files.shift_board.json: Active shift offers awaiting claim + taken_shifts history (last 100). Keys: shift_board (dict by offer id), shift_counter.
persistence_files.shift_logs.json: Historical clock in/out records (action start|end, user, shift_type, room, schedule, timestamp, tasks). Retention: last 100 entries.
persistence_files.schedules.json: Posted schedules with shift assignments (start_date, end_date, schedule_link, allow_offers, status published|draft, shifts[]). Keeps last 3.
persistence_files.panels.json: Persistent panel message IDs for view re-registration after restart: offer_shift_messages, request_timeoff_messages, clockpanel_messages.
persistence_files.timeoff_requests.json: Time-off requests: id, user_id, from_date, to_date, reason, status pending|approved|declined.
persistence_files.trades.json: Shift trade records: id (T<timestamp><rand>), requester/target ids+names, your_shift, wanted_shift, reason, status awaiting|pending|approved|declined.
persistence_files.workers_cache.json: Web-dashboard-facing worker roster: id, name, avatar_url, clocked_in, current_shift_type, clock_in_time, shifts_this_week.
persistence_files.rooms.json: Arena room/duty definitions: id, name, emoji, color, order.
persistence_files.shift_duties.json: Role-specific task lists per shift type (opener/mid/closer) and optionally per room; each task has text/show_on(start|end|both)/required.
persistence_files.../LionByteGG/data/lionshift_notificatio: Shared queue file the Nova web dashboard writes to; this bot polls it every 2s.

settings_json_keys.log_channel_id: Channel for shift clock in/out logs
settings_json_keys.webclock_url / opening_form_url / closin: URLs shown to workers during clock in/out
settings_json_keys.worker_role_id: Discord role ID for student workers
settings_json_keys.dm_shift_reminders: bool, default true — DM worker before shift
settings_json_keys.dm_late_alerts: bool, default false — DM director + worker if late

handles.schedule_announcement: Posts announcement embed + generated schedule grid image (via schedule_image.py) to Discord channel; optionally DMs all student workers
handles.dm_workers: Sends a custom broadcast DM to a specific worker_ids list

background_tasks.name: shift_reminder_task
background_tasks.does: Sends shift reminder DM ~reminder_minutes_before shift start (10-min detection window); detects late workers (late_alert_minutes after start with no clock-in) and DMs both worker and director
background_tasks.dedup: Tracks (worker_id, shift_date, shift_start) to avoid duplicate reminders

on_ready_sequence: Load panels.json, re-register persistent views (OfferShiftView, RequestTimeOffView, ClockPanelView) for every saved message
Re-register TakeOfferView for every open shift_board offer
Dynamically import + load cogs: offer-trade.py, shift-management.py (hyphenated filenames need importlib)

ui_components_main_py.OfferShiftView / OfferShiftButton: Worker's upcoming shifts -> select -> OfferReasonModal -> creates shift_board.json entry -> posts embed w/ TakeOfferView to channel, mentions student worker role
ui_components_main_py.TakeOfferView / TakeOfferButton: Claim an offered shift: validates not already claimed/not own shift, updates shift_board + transfers assignment in schedules.json, DMs original worker/director/claimer, message auto-deletes after 30s
ui_components_main_py.TradeShiftButton: Select schedule -> select target student -> TradeShiftDetailsModal (your_shift, wanted_shift, reason) -> creates trades.json entry (awaiting) -> DMs target with accept/decline, notifies director
ui_components_main_py.RequestTimeOffView / MakeRequestTimeOffB: Modal (from_date,to_date,reason) -> creates timeoff_requests.json entry (pending) -> DMs director with approve/decline buttons

slash_commands_main_py.name: /set_log_channel
slash_commands_main_py.does: Sets settings.json log_channel_id used by shift-management.py

cogs/shift-management.py.purpose: Clock in/out workflow, duty display, shift logging
helpers: send_shift_log(bot, action, user, schedule, shift_type, timestamp)

ui.StartShiftButton: Validates worker has an assigned/picked-up/traded shift today -> 2-step WebClock confirmation -> shows role/room duties (openers must submit opening form first)
ui.EndShiftButton: Validates currently clocked in -> shows end tasks -> closers get a 3-step Clock Out / Closing Form / Final Clock Out flow; others simpler
ui.ClockPanelView: Persistent Start Shift + End Shift buttons, created via /setup_clockpanel

commands.name: /offer_shift
commands.does: Offer one of your assigned shifts (published schedules only, today or later, max 25 select options)

commands.name: /trade_shift
commands.does: Initiate a shift trade with another student worker (director approval required)

cogs/offer-trade.py.purpose: Shift offering/claiming/trading UI + director approval workflow
cogs/offer-trade.py.trade_workflow: Student A -> trade request -> Student B accepts -> Director approval -> both notified

cogs/ggleap_guests.py.status: Currently empty placeholder for future GGLeap guest tracking integration

types: schedule_announcement (posts + generates image + optional DM blast)

schedule_image_generation.layout: Header (name+logo+date badge) -> stats row (total shifts/days/trading status) -> 7-day grid (up to 6 shifts/day, '+N more') -> footer timestamp

error_handling.on_app_command_error: Catches MissingPermissions -> 'you do not have permission'; re-raises others
error_handling.process_notification_queue.error: Logs error, waits 30s, restarts the loop
